title: 第二十五章 灵气化形第二十六章 复测之日
content_zh:
“噗！”
当整整一天的时间过去之后，姜云那伸出的右手食指之上陡然腾起了一朵指甲大小的火花，散发着微弱的温度。
看着这摇曳不定，随时都有可能熄灭的火花，姜云的脸上却是露出了兴奋的神色，可这兴奋也就仅仅持续了片刻，就化作了不解。
姜云皱着眉头，盯着火花自言自语的道：“按照书上所说，通脉三重之境，凝聚体内灵气就能产生巴掌大的火球，而我已经是通脉五重之境，灵气已然能够外放，形成的火球也足以达到西瓜大小，可为什么只能打出一朵这么小的火花？”
“过程方法都对，那到底是哪里出了问题？”
自语声中，姜云一边继续不断的在十指之上腾起一朵朵的火花，一边认真思索着。
与此同时，身在自己屋中的东方博忽然微微一笑，轻声开口道：“二师妹，不指点一下吗？”
二师妹的声音立刻响起道：“我说过，如果他在修道之上能入我眼的话，我或许会指点一下，但现在，还不行！更何况，师父领进门，修行在个人！如果这点问题都需要别人来指导，那他这辈子也不会有什么大的出息。”
东方博却是摇摇头道：“他这不是还没有师父吗！”
二师妹冷冷的道：“这问道宗内超过万名弟子都没有师父，难不成我还一个个的去为他们指点吗？”
东方博干笑一声道：“嘿嘿，我也就说说而已，你要真的指点，我还不同意呢！毕竟修道除了自身的努力之外，也的确讲究一个‘悟’字，想当初的我们，也都是这么一步步的走过来的！只是不知道，姜老弟需要多久，才能发现问题所在！”
二师妹沉默片刻才再次开口道：“当初我们之中，三师弟最快，用了三天时间，我们拭目以待，看看他需要多久吧！”
又是一天之后，从姜云的屋子之中陡然传出了一道欢呼声：“我明白了！”
经过这一天一夜不眠不休的反复琢磨和研究，姜云尽管双眼之中布满了血色，面色也是无比的苍白，但脸上却是带着欣喜的笑容，看着掌心之中，那鸡蛋大小的火焰。
“灵气！”姜云长吐一口气道：“灵气外放固然能够让灵气的威力加大，但是外放之后，绝大部分的灵气却也全都浪费掉了，故而当初只能形成小火花！”
“也就是说，我要想让术法能够发挥出威力，就必须要先学会控制我体内的灵气，最好能够做到不浪费一分一毫！”
“只是，如何才能更好的控制我的灵气呢？”
随着姜云再次的陷入了沉思，藏峰之上也悄然响起了东方博声音：“一天就发现了，这孩子，不但修炼神速，而且悟性也是惊人啊！”
“不然！”二师妹轻声道：“他的悟性如何我不好说，但他能这么快就发现问题所在，应该是得益于他敏锐的观察，我突然很好奇，在拜入问道宗前，他的生活到底是什么样的了，一个从没接触过修炼的凡人，不应该会具备这样的观察力！”
“我也很好奇！”东方博点点头道：“不过，师父说过，不要打探一个人的过去，所以如果他不是主动说出来，我们也不要问了！”

二师妹淡淡的道：“或许，他真有可能成为我们的四师弟！”
这一次，东方博没有再说话，只是看着姜云身在的方向，脸上露出了一抹期待之色。
这时的姜云忽然从屋里冲了出去，在院子的地下扒拉了半天，手上已经多出了一堆小石子，每颗都有拳头大小。
姜云也不回屋了，直接一屁股坐在了地上，将这堆小石子在面前平铺开来，又在旁边放了一个石碗之后，双眼死死的盯着石子，一道灵气从其指尖射出，蓦然冲入了石子之中。
就如同起了一阵旋风一样，四散的灵气顿时将这些石子激荡了开来，而接着，姜云的指尖之中不断的有灵气射出，没入那些石子之中。
这一幕，自然引起了东方博二人的注意。
“他在干什么？”
“好像，是想用灵气将所有的石子，捡入碗中。”
二师妹难得的发出了笑声道：“哈哈，还没学会走，就先想着跑！虽然这是一个笨法子，也的确能够增强对灵气的控制，但是，少了一个步骤！”
content_en:
"Poof!"
When a whole day passed, a spark the size of a fingernail suddenly appeared on Jiang Yun's outstretched right index finger, exuding a faint warmth.
Looking at the swaying sparks that could go out at any time, Jiang Yun's face showed excitement, but this excitement only lasted for a moment before turning into confusion.
Jiang Yun frowned, stared at the sparks and muttered to himself: "According to the book, at the third level of Tongmai, condensing the spiritual energy in the body can produce a fireball as big as a palm. But I am already at the fifth level of Tongmai, and my spiritual energy can already be released, and the fireball formed can reach the size of a watermelon, but why can I only produce such a small spark?"
"The process and methods are correct, so what exactly went wrong?"
While muttering to himself, Jiang Yun continued to raise sparks on his fingers while thinking seriously.
At the same time, Dongfang Bo, who was in his room, suddenly smiled and said softly: "Second Junior Sister, don't you give me some advice?"
The second junior sister's voice immediately sounded: "I said, if he can catch my eye in terms of cultivation, I might give him some advice, but right now, it's not possible! What's more, Master brings him in, and cultivation is personal! If he needs guidance from others on this matter, then he won't have much success in this life."
Dongfang Bo shook his head and said, "He doesn't have a master yet!"
The second junior sister said coldly: "There are more than 10,000 disciples in the Taoist sect who don't have a master. Is it possible that I have to give them guidance one by one?"
Dongfang Bo laughed and said: "Hey, I'm just talking. If you really want to give me some advice, I still don't agree! After all, in addition to your own efforts, Taoism also pays attention to the word 'enlightenment'. I think we all walked through it step by step like this! I just don't know how long it will take Brother Jiang to discover the problem!"
The second junior sister was silent for a moment before speaking again: "Among us, the third junior brother was the fastest at the beginning. It took three days. Let's wait and see how long it takes him!"
Another day later, a cheer suddenly came from Jiang Yun's house: "I understand!"
After a day and a night of sleepless thinking and research, Jiang Yun, although his eyes were filled with blood and his face was extremely pale, had a joyful smile on his face as he looked at the egg-sized flame in his palm.
"Aura!" Jiang Yunchang took a long breath and said: "The release of the aura can certainly increase the power of the aura, but after the aura is released, most of the aura is wasted, so only small sparks can be formed at the beginning!"
"In other words, if I want my spell to be able to exert its power, I must first learn to control the spiritual energy in my body. It is best to not waste a single cent!"
"But, how can I better control my spiritual energy?"
As Jiang Yun fell into deep thought again, Dongfang Bo's voice quietly sounded from the top of the hidden peak: "I discovered in just one day that this child not only cultivates very fast, but also has amazing understanding!"
"Otherwise!" Second Junior Sister said softly: "I can't say what his understanding is, but the fact that he was able to discover the problem so quickly should be due to his keen observation. I was suddenly very curious about what his life was like before joining the Taoist Sect. A mortal who has never been exposed to cultivation should not have such observation!"
"I'm curious too!" Dongfang Bo nodded and said, "However, Master said, don't inquire about a person's past, so if he doesn't take the initiative to tell us, we shouldn't ask!"
The second junior sister said calmly: "Perhaps, he really might become our fourth junior brother!"
This time, Dongfang Bo didn't speak anymore, he just looked in the direction of Jiang Yun with a look of expectation on his face.
At this time, Jiang Yun suddenly rushed out of the roomI went and dug in the ground of the yard for a long time. I already had a bunch of small stones in my hand, each one the size of a fist.
Jiang Yun didn't go back to the house. He sat down on the ground and spread the pile of pebbles in front of him. After placing a stone bowl next to it, he stared at the pebbles with his eyes. A ray of spiritual energy shot out from his fingertips and suddenly rushed into the pebbles.
Just like a whirlwind, the scattered spiritual energy suddenly stirred up the stones, and then, spiritual energy continued to shoot out from Jiang Yun's fingertips and submerged into the stones.
This scene naturally attracted the attention of Dongfang Bo and his two brothers.
"What is he doing?"
"It seems that I want to use spiritual energy to pick up all the stones into the bowl."
The second junior sister gave a rare laugh and said: "Haha, I haven't learned to walk yet, so I want to run first! Although this is a stupid method, it can indeed enhance the control of spiritual energy, but there is one missing step!"
